editions.title: Last week on E-Grid
editions.intro: Two round-21 races head this week's calendar, with Formula 1 on the Las Vegas Strip and MotoGP at the Algarve, both running Sunday 22 November. Here is what happened as the seasons reached their climax.

items.headline: Las Vegas Grand Prix
items.detail: Las Vegas Strip Street Circuit, USA · Sun 22 Nov
items.body: Max Verstappen took the Las Vegas Grand Prix from pole, holding off Lando Norris by 0.6 seconds on a dry evening at 12°C. Oscar Piastri was one of the night's biggest climbers, recovering from 17th to third, with Carlos Sainz also gaining ground to eighth. A lap-19 safety car and a single stop on soft then medium tyres shaped the race, while Andrea Kimi Antonelli's championship lead over Verstappen narrowed from 111 to 98 points.
facts: Max Verstappen won from pole, 0.6 seconds ahead of Lando Norris
Biggest climbers: Oscar Piastri from 17th to 3rd and Carlos Sainz from 20th to 8th
Fastest lap: Liam Lawson, 1:35.591
Did not finish: Fernando Alonso, Arvid Lindblad, Sergio Pérez and Alexander Albon (did not start)
Andrea Kimi Antonelli's championship lead over Max Verstappen went from 111 to 98 points over the weekend
Safety car on lap 19

items.headline: Grand Prix of Portugal
items.detail: Autódromo Internacional do Algarve, Portugal · Sun 22 Nov
items.body: Marco Bezzecchi won the Grand Prix of Portugal, edging teammate Jorge Martin by 3.8 seconds at the Algarve on a warm, dry day. He had already taken Saturday's sprint, and set a new lap record of 1:39.121 in the race. Raul Fernandez completed the podium, while four riders fell out, including Marc Marquez, whose championship lead over Martin slipped from 60 to 43 points.

Did not finish: Diogo Moreira, Alex Marquez, Pedro Acosta and Johann Zarco
Marco Bezzecchi set a new lap record, 1:39.121
Dry, 19°C air and 25°C track
Saturday's sprint was won by Marco Bezzecchi

editions.intro: Two Sunday races closed out this weekend's action: Max Verstappen took the Las Vegas Grand Prix and Marco Bezzecchi won the Portuguese Grand Prix in MotoGP. Both results are in, with championship standings shifting across Formula 1 and MotoGP.

Andrea Kimi Antonelli kept his championship lead after the result narrowed his advantage over Verstappen from 111 to 98 points. A lap-19 safety car and a soft-then-medium one-stop strategy shaped the dry, 12°C race.

lastRaces.headline: NHRA Finals
lastRaces.body: The NHRA Finals brought the series' culminating event to Pomona Dragstrip in California on Sunday 15 November. This familiar Southern California venue played host to the season finale, marking the end of another year of drag racing.

lastRaces.headline: Rally Saudi Arabia
lastRaces.body: The latest World Rally Championship round was Rally Saudi Arabia, staged around Jeddah on Sat 14 Nov. The field took out onto the stages for a full weekend of competition.

lastRaces.headline: Championship Race
lastRaces.body: Ryan Blaney won from ninth on the grid, holding Tyler Reddick of 23XI Racing for a 0.314-second margin in a 267-lap race in which eight drivers traded the lead. William Byron completed the podium for Hendrick Motorsports behind him, while Larson's Chase edge over Bell fell from 67 to 49 points.

Most laps led: Denny Hamlin (87)
Stage winners: Stage 1 Tyler Reddick, Stage 2 Denny Hamlin
Margin of victory: 0.314 s
Kyle Larson's Chase lead over Christopher Bell went from 67 to 49 points this weekend, with the title decided

lastRaces.headline: Portimão
lastRaces.detail: Autódromo Internacional do Algarve, Portugal · Sun 8 Nov
lastRaces.body: Portimão's round of the Clio Cup Series ran on Sunday across the Autódromo Internacional do Algarve in Portugal. It was a day of touring-car racing that rounded out the week alongside the season's headline events.

lastRaces.headline: 8 Hours of Bahrain
lastRaces.body: The 8 Hours of Bahrain served as round eight of the World Endurance Championship, staged on Saturday 7 November at the Bahrain International Circuit. It was a demanding endurance test that brought the series back to the desert for its latest round.

lastRaces.headline: Motul Petit Le Mans
lastRaces.detail: Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta · Sat 3 Oct
lastRaces.body: IMSA's SportsCar Championship reaches its finale with the Motul Petit Le Mans at Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta on Saturday 3 October. The endurance marathon has long stood as the series' crowning event, capping another demanding season of sports car racing.

lastRaces.headline: Baku
lastRaces.detail: Baku City Circuit, Azerbaijan · Sun 27 Sep
lastRaces.body: Formula 2 brought its sprint and feature races to the Baku City Circuit in Azerbaijan on Sunday 27 September. The narrow street track threading the old city's walls offered another tight, technical test for the feeder series.

lastRaces.headline: Madrid
lastRaces.body: Formula 3's tenth round came to Madrid, Spain on Sunday 13 September. The championship's Spanish round brought its racing to the city that weekend.

lastRaces.headline: Monza (double-header)
lastRaces.detail: Autodromo Nazionale Monza, Italy · Sun 6 Sep
lastRaces.body: Autodromo Nazionale Monza has hosted racing since 1922, its 5.793 km lap threading through 11 corners. The Porsche Supercup's seventh round ran here on Sunday 6 September as a double-header in Italy.
facts: 5.793 km lap, 11 corners, first raced 1922

lastRaces.headline: Season Finale
lastRaces.detail: WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca · Sun 6 Sep
lastRaces.body: IndyCar's season finale reached WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca on Sunday 6 September. As the championship's final round of the year, it brought the season to a close at the venue.
